evidence_limits.note: data/validation_report.json, questions.jsonl, orphans.jsonl, unmatched_images.jsonl, state.json, assets and the source PDF live on the Railway volume and were NOT available in the sandbox. This matrix is built from the deployment log (54 chunks parsed) + source-code inspection. Source-page-level proof for each flag requires the volume artifacts; see remaining_uncertainty.

root_causes.title: Stale-path image lifecycle: figure-map claims rename temp files but the caller keeps the stale temp names -> 4th-pass FileNotFoundError -> false 'unmatched image'
evidence: [IMG] figure-map: PSY/PSY-p67-150.webp -> PSY-005-003 (question side, model-declared)
[INFO] Page 67: image(s) ['PSY/PSY-p67-150.webp', 'PSY/PSY-p67-151.webp'] unclaimed for now
[IMG] attribution call failed for PSY/PSY-p67-150.webp: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/data/qbank_output_v2/assets/questions/PSY/PSY-p67-150.webp'
root_causes.mechanism: claim_figure_map_images renames (moves) each claimed temp file to its final slot name. The run-9 window loop only updated leftover_by_page[page] for pages present in fig_leftover; a page whose images were ALL claimed is absent from fig_leftover, so its STALE TEMP NAMES stayed in the leftover list -> appended to unmatched_images -> the 4th pass tried to open a moved file -> FileNotFoundError -> logged as unmatched even though the image WAS owned.
root_causes.affected: ch3 unmatched:1, ch5 unmatched:1, ch6 unmatched:1, ch7 unmatched:1, ch9 unmatched:2 (and any chapter where the figure-map claimed images)
root_causes.fix: window loop now clears leftover_by_page[page] = [] for every page fed to the figure-map that is absent from fig_leftover; attribute_orphan_image returns {'decorative':'already_claimed'} for missing files (no Gemini call); the 4th pass drops already-claimed refs instead of recording unmatched.

root_causes.title: q_no=None items with REAL content (options, stems, solutions) silently orphaned; never reconciled to the stem-less records they belong to
evidence: [WARN] Gemini returned an item with no q_no, skipping: {'q_no': None, 'question_text': None, 'options': {'A': 'Kleine-Levin syndrome...', ...}} (x5, ch2 pages 30-33)
[GEMINI:Q] pages 30-33 | items: 5 | orphans buffered: 5
chapter 2 done -> 16 questions (2 missing answer, ...) | orphans: 5 unresolved
root_causes.mechanism: merge_question_records skips q_no=None items into the orphan buffer; recover_orphans rule 3 needs last_qn_in_batch, which is None when the whole window's items are q_no=None fragments; the fragments carry options for stem-less records (q25/q26) that are NEVER reconciled.
root_causes.affected: ch2 q25/q26 stem-less + 5 unresolved orphans; ch7 q1/q23-26; ch10; ch31; ch33 orphans
root_causes.fix: not fully solvable without page coordinates; improved answer-key targeting + export gate make the gap EXPLICIT instead of silent; q_no=None items with options and no stem are now reportable via the export gate. Full fix requires per-fragment page coords (see remaining_uncertainty).

root_causes.title: Contaminated-stem catch-22: sweep strips a stem whose text overlaps the record's solution; retry/rescue return the same class of text and are blocked again -> the record ships STEM-LESS while '0 missing answer / 0 missing solution' hides it
evidence: [SWEEP] q3/q4/q10: stripped contaminated stem ... targeted retry will refill it
[RETRY] blocked contaminated stem for q3 ... still stem-missing
[RESCUE] page 14: q4 -> 0 field(s) filled
chapter 1 done -> 26 questions (0 missing answer, 0 missing solution)
root_causes.mechanism: the stem-text-in-own-solution check is correct for the Option-A/B-prose class (ch7 q1 'Option A: CAGE questionnaire...'), but when the real stem was never captured the retry keeps offering solution-like text; the guard blocks it (correctly) and nothing refills the stem. The chapter summary counted ONLY answers/solutions, so stem-less records were invisible.
root_causes.affected: ch1 q3/q4/q10, ch2 q25/q26, ch6 q5, ch7 q1/q23-26, ch9 q5, ch10 q5, ch32 q5 (typical)
root_causes.fix: summary now reports missing stem + bad options; export gate flags missing_stem; rescue uses field-specific prompts so a stem re-ask asks ONLY for the stem region.

root_causes.title: Missing answers despite an answer key in source: A-pass returns fewer key rows than the chapter has questions, and nothing cross-checks
evidence: ch7: A-pass pages 108-111 items: 9 -> chapter 7 done -> 14 questions (4 missing answer)
ch2: 2 missing answer; ch18: 1; ch19: 2; ch24: 2 (user report)
root_causes.mechanism: the A-pass only fires when KEY_TABLE_PROBE_RE matches the window's text; a key table spanning pages outside the probed window, or a partial table read, silently leaves answers missing. No stage verifies 'answer table visibly contains qN -> answer must be filled'.
root_causes.affected: ch7 (4), ch2 (2), ch18 (1), ch19 (2), ch24 (2) — user-reported
root_causes.fix: locate_missing_record_pages now also finds ANSWER-KEY pages for answer-missing records; rescue uses an answer-only prompt (answer_rescue_prompt); export gate flags missing_answer so it can no longer hide.

root_causes.title: Rescue returns 0 fields: broad prompt + wrong target page + contamination/scope filters
evidence: [RESCUE] page 14: q4 -> 0 field(s) filled
[RESCUE] page 22: q25,26 -> 0 field(s) filled
[RESCUE] page 100: q23,24,25,26 -> 0 field(s) filled
ch7 rescue: 0 filled / 2 calls; ch2 rescue: 0/1
root_causes.mechanism: rescue re-asked the whole record with the broad targeted-retry prompt; for answer gaps it targeted the QUESTION page (not the answer-table page) and the returned text was often filtered by scope/contamination rules -> 0 fields.
root_causes.fix: field-specific prompts (answer-only ask for answer gaps) + answer-key page targeting; a rescue that fills 0 fields is now visible via the ledger (PARTIAL/UNRESOLVED status) instead of being counted as a completed recovery.

root_causes.title: 503 / finish_reason=4 handling works (single-page retry + drain recovered pages) but recovery completeness is not asserted
evidence: [GEMINI_ERROR] page-336.jpg: status=503 ... queued for second-chance drain
[DRAIN] page-336.jpg recovered on second chance
[GEMINI_ERROR] page-352..356: status=503 ... single-page retry: 5/5 pages recovered
ch31 S-pass batch 340 503 -> single-page retry: 2/2 recovered
root_causes.mechanism: retries recovered the observed pages; but nothing tracks whether the recovery satisfied the page's extraction OBLIGATION (a page may come back 'recovered' with 0 items).
root_causes.fix: page/pass ledger with structured status (SUCCESS/EXPECTED_EMPTY/PARTIAL/RETRYABLE_FAILURE/UNRESOLVED) persisted to data/page_ledger.jsonl; chapter-end gate surfaces UNRESOLVED passes.

root_causes.title: Section-boundary announcement fires repeatedly (every S window) because the text-layer S label never set the seen flag
evidence: [SECTION] solutions section begins at page 13 ... (ch1)
[SECTION] solutions section begins at page 17 ... (ch1)
[SECTION] solutions section begins at page 22 / page 26 / page 30 ... (ch2)
root_causes.mechanism: run-8 deliberately kept solutions_section_seen managed by the EXTRACTION boundary (so Q-pass stays active for questions tailing into solutions); the S-window branch re-logged + re-reset on EVERY S window because it never set any flag.
root_causes.fix: solutions_section_announced flag: the boundary is announced and carry reset once per chapter; Q-pass activation logic unchanged.
root_causes.regression_test: (covered by existing section tests; behavior verified in code)

remaining_uncertainty: data/validation_report.json (96 flags) was not available; the exact per-flag breakdown and source-page lineage for each of the 96 flags still requires the volume artifacts.
The source PDF was not available in the sandbox, so page-render verification of specific questions (e.g. whether ch7's answer table truly has 14 rows) was not possible.

RC-2 (q_no=None reconciliation) is only partially fixed: full reconciliation needs per-fragment page coordinates + preceding/following printed anchors, which the current extraction does not retain. This remains the highest open risk.

A full clean re-run (archive -> reset -> re-extract the same PDF) cannot be executed from this sandbox: no PDF, no GEMINI_API_KEY, no Railway volume. The pipeline now emits export_gate.jsonl + page_ledger.jsonl so the next deployment run is auditable end-to-end.
